title: CovarianceSmoothConvex.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained convex differentiable f:E→ℝ with globally L-Lipschitz gradient, L>0. A global minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R, R≥0; strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call at x returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed. The oracle is jointly measurable and unbiased: E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Only gradient replies are supplied. All parameters, including L,R,σ,s,ε,δ,x0, are public; f and the oracle distribution are hidden.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniformly in x, E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ², and uniformly in x,v, E⟨v,g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)⟩²≤s²‖v‖², with 0≤s≤σ. Total variance and directional covariance bounds are supplied separately; no exponential-tail condition is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CovarianceSmoothConvex.lean: IsCovarianceGradient.covariance and spec.valid; LongTails/Setups/StochasticSmoothAndConvex.lean: IsStochasticGradient.variance_integrable and variance.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real complete inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure. No dimension bound is specified.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output X satisfying f(X)−f(x⋆)≤ε, ε>0, on the success event; no particular iterate is required.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(X)−f(x⋆)>ε)≤δ for 0<δ<1, under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness, within a fixed budget counting every stochastic-gradient reply.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The smooth convex stochastic optimization formulation distinguishes a total second-moment bound from a potentially smaller directional covariance bound under IID finite-variance noise, with a high-probability objective-gap requirement.

descriptionHtml:
Covariance-Controlled Smooth Convex Minimization

We minimize a differentiable convex function f:E→R on a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space E. Its gradient is L-Lipschitz, with L>0, and a given point x0∈E is within distance R≥0 of a minimizer x⋆. At x, the oracle returns an unbiased gradient estimate g(x,ξ) using independent samples ξ from a probability law p. The noise has second moment bounded by σ2 and covariance bounded by s2 times the identity, where 0≤s≤σ. For ε>0 and δ∈(0,1), the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E with P{f(x¯)−f(x⋆)>ε}≤δ, where P is the law of all algorithm and oracle randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). Write ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ for the inner product on E and ∥⋅∥ for its induced norm. The algorithm receives E, the measurable sample space Ω, x0, L, R, σ, s, ε, and δ.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E. For every x,y∈E and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y),∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Initial distance). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Assumption 3 (Stochastic gradient and covariance). There are a probability measure p on Ω and a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E. For every x∈E, the random vector g(x,ξ) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥2 is integrable under ξ∼p. For every x,v∈E, Eξ∼p[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼p[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥2]≤σ2,Eξ∼p[⟨v,g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)⟩2]≤s2∥v∥2. At call k=0,1,…, a query x∈E receives the reply g(x,ξk). The sample variables (ξk)k≥0 are measurable, mutually independent, and each has law p. The algorithm’s randomness is independent of the entire sample sequence.

Queries may be made at any point of E. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable and satisfy P{f(x¯)−f(x⋆)>ε}≤δ.

comparisonHtml:
Convex differentiable f on a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space, with L-Lipschitz gradient and an unconstrained minimizer x⋆ satisfying ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. Fresh IID samples supply a jointly measurable, integrable unbiased gradient g(x,ξ); its squared centered norm is integrable, with E∥g−∇f∥2≤σ2 and E⟨v,g−∇f⟩2≤s2∥v∥2 for every x,v. Here L,ε>0, R≥0, 0≤s≤σ, 0<δ<1; parameters are supplied. Target: measurable x^ with P{f(x^)−f(x⋆)>ε}≤δ.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.CovarianceSmoothConvex

open OracleTemplate

structure Params extends StochasticSmoothAndConvex.Params.{0} where
  [finiteDimensionalE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  s : ℝ
  δ : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.finiteDimensionalE

structure IsCovarianceGradient {E : Type*} {Ω : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (p : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure p] (f : E → ℝ)
    (g : E → Ω → E) (σ s : ℝ) : Prop
    extends StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient E Ω p f g σ where
  covariance : ∀ x v, (∫ ω, ⟪v, g x ω - gradient f x⟫ ^ 2 ∂p) ≤ s ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance q := q.E → ℝ
  Query q := q.E
  Reply q := q.E
  Output q := q.E
  publicInput q := q
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 0 ≤ q.s ∧ q.s ≤ q.σ ∧
    0 < q.ε ∧ 0 < q.δ ∧ q.δ < 1
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k)
      (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) seed => g x seed } ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R) ∧
    IsCovarianceGradient (p : Measure _) f g q.σ q.s
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      (P : Measure _) {ω | q.ε < f (output ω) - f xstar} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal q.δ

end LongTails.Setups.CovarianceSmoothConvex
